name: Expand Energy

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org (Expand Logo.svg; en.wikipedia infobox logo field is empty)

description: Expand Energy (formerly Chesapeake) calls itself the largest independent natural gas producer in the US by net daily production. It drills gas wells in the Haynesville (Louisiana and Texas) and Appalachia (Marcellus and Utica), sells mostly gas under index or spot-priced contracts, and a small amount of oil and NGLs. The October 1, 2024 Southwestern merger more than doubled its size, so 2025 revenue and production jumped; it also runs a marketing arm and large derivative hedges that make reported results swing.

employees.note: Approximately 1,600 employees; none under collective bargaining.

businessLines.name: Natural gas, oil and NGL sales (own production)
businessLines.how: Sells gas, oil and NGLs at index or daily spot prices at the wellhead and market hubs; revenue = volume times a market price, so it rises and falls with natural gas prices.

businessLines.name: Marketing
businessLines.how: Buys and resells gas, oil and NGLs from other working-interest owners in its operated wells and arranges gathering, transport and storage; earns a small spread on a large revenue figure.

businessLines.name: Gain (loss) on derivatives
businessLines.how: Mark-to-market and settled results on hedges of future gas sales, recorded in revenue.

brands.name: Southwestern Energy
brands.note: Merger completed 2024-10-01 (Southwest Appalachia and Haynesville assets); Haynesville production rose from 1,532 to 3,000 MMcfe/d between 2024 and 2025.
